description: This file defines an enum for different email message status types within the Apache Fineract project, used to represent the state of email messages such as pending, sent, delivered, and failed.

classes.name: EmailMessageStatusType
classes.description: An enum representing various statuses of an email message, including INVALID, PENDING, SENT, DELIVERED, and FAILED. It provides methods to map integer values to enum instances and to check specific statuses.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to the corresponding EmailMessageStatusType enum value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the email message status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the email message status.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the status is pending.

methods.name: isSent
methods.description: Checks if the status is sent.
